installCommand: if [ -z "$UI_REPO_TOKEN" ]; then echo 'UI_REPO_TOKEN is not set, so git cannot fetch the private @autostand/ui. See README.md -> Deploying to Vercel.' >&2; exit 1; fi; git config --global url."https://x-access-token:$UI_REPO_TOKEN@github.com/".insteadOf "ssh://git@github.com/"; git config --global --add url."https://x-access-token:$UI_REPO_TOKEN@github.com/".insteadOf "git@github.com:"; git config --global --add url."https://x-access-token:$UI_REPO_TOKEN@github.com/".insteadOf "https://github.com/"; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
